metadata.name: LLM Compliance
metadata.description: AI/LLM compliance evidence collection toolkit with 24 templates, 21 interactive assessment tools, automated evidence extraction, and multi-jurisdiction regulatory coverage
metadata.author: Justice

skills.name: ai-compliance
skills.description: AI/LLM regulatory compliance knowledge covering 16+ jurisdictions including EU AI Act, GDPR, US state laws, UK AI governance, and frameworks like NIST AI RMF and ISO 42001

skills.name: evidence-collection
skills.description: Automated and interactive evidence collection pipeline with 24 templates, 3 extractors (git, package, CI), autofill, and validation for compliance documentation

commands.name: compliance-assessment
commands.description: Assess an AI/LLM system against applicable regulations for identified jurisdictions and generate a compliance gap analysis

project_path.description: Path to the AI/LLM project to assess

jurisdictions.description: Target jurisdictions: eu, uk, us, canada, china, japan, korea, india, singapore, australia, nz, mexico, africa

risk_level.description: AI system risk classification: minimal, limited, high, unacceptable

commands.name: extract-evidence
commands.description: Automatically extract compliance evidence from git history, package metadata, and CI/CD configuration

project_path.description: Path to the project to extract evidence from

commands.name: autofill-templates
commands.description: Populate compliance evidence templates with extracted data and configuration values

config_path.description: Path to compliance-config.json with project metadata

templates.description: Specific template numbers to fill (e.g., 01, 02, 15). Empty for all.

commands.name: validate-evidence
commands.description: Run evidence-checker to validate completeness and identify gaps in collected compliance documentation

output_dir.description: Path to directory containing filled evidence templates

strict.description: Enable strict mode — fail on any incomplete template

commands.name: jurisdiction-lookup
commands.description: Look up applicable AI regulations, deadlines, and requirements for a specific jurisdiction

jurisdiction.description: Jurisdiction to look up: eu, uk, us, canada, china, japan, korea, india, singapore, australia, nz, mexico, africa, or global

templates.name: compliance-config
templates.description: Configuration template for project metadata and compliance settings

templates.name: compliance-report
templates.description: Generated compliance assessment report template with audit-artifact Provenance Block, jurisdiction crosswalk, composite scoring, and addendum-trigger criteria
